en.楚三闾大夫,投汨罗而死。: Grand Master of Chu, who drowned himself in the Miluo.
en.含冤负屈,六月飞雪。: Wronged, and it snowed in June.
en.挟天子以令诸侯。: Held the emperor hostage to command the lords.
en.以莫须有之罪杀岳飞。: Had Yue Fei killed on a charge of 'perhaps'.
en.饥年开仓,赈济乡里: Opened the granary in a famine year
en.拾金不昧,守候失主: Found gold and waited for its owner
en.奉养老母至终: Cared for an aged mother to the end
en.伪造地契,夺人田产: Forged a deed and took a neighbour's land
en.教唆杀人,以灭其口: Ordered a killing to silence a witness
en.功过相抵后仍有余善,准入轮回。: Merit remains after the balance; rebirth is granted.
en.恶业深重,依律发落。: Heavy evil karma; sentenced according to the statutes.
en.今日当值第五殿,孽镜台前无人敢抬头。: On duty at the Fifth Court today. No one dares look up at the Mirror of Retribution.
en.孟婆汤新换了配方,说是少放了黄连。: Meng Po has a new recipe. Less coptis, she says.
en.奈何桥下水位上涨,诸位摆渡注意。: The water is rising under Naihe Bridge. Ferrymen, take care.
en.崔判官的朱笔又断了,这是本月第三支。: Judge Cui's vermilion brush has snapped again, the third this month.
en.第一殿排队已到午门外,请勿喧哗。: The queue for the First Court reaches the gate. Quiet, please.
en.此帖有扰公堂清净: This post disturbs the peace of the court
en.待阳间证人到案: Waiting for a witness from the living
en.项羽案·两界会审: The Xiang Yu case: joint judgment
en.两界共审,先地府后冥河: Tried by both realms, Diyu first and then the Styx
en.外邦亡魂,移交第五殿: A foreign soul, handed to the Fifth Court
en.两界会审,押赴岔路草原: Joint judgment: taken to the Meadow
en.战死异乡,请地府收押: Died in battle abroad; please take custody
en.请真理殿堂称心: Asking the Hall of Two Truths to weigh the heart
en.愿再世为人,弥补前愆。: I ask to live again and make amends.
en.证据未全,请求复审。: The evidence was incomplete; I ask for a review.
en.冥河彼岸新出证人,请求重开此案。: A new witness has come from across the Styx; please reopen.
en.地府核定刑期有误,请原审复核。: The term set in Diyu looks wrong; please review.
en.赦令已下,请原审确认是否重开。: An amnesty has been issued; please confirm whether to reopen.
en.本殿执行时发现判词与卷宗不符。: On execution we found the verdict does not match the file.
en.第五殿队列有新案: A new case in the Fifth Court's queue
en.有一件结案等你批: A concluded case needs your approval
en.有灵魂调入本殿: A soul has been transferred here
en.生前无大罪,准入天堂。: No grave sin in life; admitted to Heaven.
en.所犯之罪依《神曲》定层,入地狱。: The sin decides the circle, after the Comedy; sent to Hell.
en.其罪可涤,入炼狱逐层洗炼。: The sin can be cleansed; sent to Purgatory, terrace by terrace.
en.心不重于羽,入芦苇原。: The heart is no heavier than the feather; to the Field of Reeds.
en.心重于羽,交阿米特吞噬。: The heart is heavier than the feather; given to Ammit.
en.善者往至福岛,千年后再择来生。: The good go to the Isles of the Blessed; after a thousand years they choose again.
en.恶者下塔尔塔罗斯。: The wicked go down to Tartarus.
en.外邦新出证人,请求重开此案。: A new witness from abroad; please reopen.
en.新出证人,请求重审。: A new witness; asking for a rehearing.
en.赦罪令已下,请原审确认是否重开。: An absolution has been issued; please confirm whether to reopen.
en.真理殿堂发现判词与卷宗不符。: The Hall of Two Truths found the verdict does not match the file.
en.请求重新称量。: Asking for the heart to be weighed again.
en.判官存疑,请米诺斯复核。: The judges are in doubt; asking Minos to review.
en.炼狱队列有新案: A new case in Purgatory's queue
en.真理殿堂队列有新案: A new case in the Hall of Two Truths' queue
en.岔路草原队列有新案: A new case at the Meadow's queue
en.本殿队列有新案: A new case in the queue
en.有灵魂调入第五殿: A soul has been transferred to the Fifth Court
en.有灵魂调入炼狱: A soul has been transferred to Purgatory
en.有灵魂调入真理殿堂: A soul has been transferred to the Hall of Two Truths
en.有灵魂调入岔路草原: A soul has been transferred to the Meadow
en.判官问我何以至此。对酒当歌,人生几何。他说这不算答辩。: The judge asked how I came to this. I said: sing to your wine, for how long is a life? He said that is not a defence.
en.雷峰塔的潮气比这里重。在此报个平安。: Leifeng Pagoda was damper than this. All is well.
en.有人说我多管闲事。此间判官也这么写。: They said I meddled. The judge here wrote the same.
en.无颜见江东父老,倒在这里见着了。: I could not face the elders of Jiangdong. I met them here instead.
en.转生形态那一栏我填了蝶。被退回来了。: Under form of rebirth I wrote butterfly. It came back.
en.下次一起填人道。: Next time we both write human.
en.和他一起递的转生申请。表格上没有「同去」这一栏。: We filed for rebirth together. The form has no box for together.
en.今日又有人跪我。不用了,真的。: Someone knelt at my statue again today. Please stop.
